invariants: Every queued scheduler work item has one external_milestone.
Work without a defensible external milestone is suppressed rather than queued to keep the Brain busy.
External-value blockers outrank demand validation, which outranks deliverable completion, which outranks internal blockers.
Internal repair/test/verification may enter the queue only when it directly blocks an external milestone.
TECHNICAL_VERIFIED may improve technical/model routing but cannot increase business investment.
Only MARKET_VERIFIED and REVENUE_VERIFIED may increase business investment.
PUBLIC_GITHUB is a supply sensor only and never proves customer demand.
Publishing, spending, payment setup and consequential customer communication remain human-approved actions.
Owner-action completion is inferred only from new verified external/source evidence; the queue does not paint itself green.
